title: AI
intro: Connect AI to ask about your data in plain language: diary, finance, birthdays, websites, music, games. It also enables the morning digest in Telegram, the /ask bot command and diary summaries.
placeholder: Ask anything about your data… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)

attach.hint: Attach a file: a bank statement, a receipt… (PDF, Excel, CSV, text)
attach.unsupported: {{name}}: only PDF, Excel (.xlsx), CSV and text files can be read
attach.empty: {{name}} has no text — probably a scan. Export it as a PDF with text or CSV
attach.truncated: {{name}} is long: only its beginning will be sent

suggestions.birthdays: Which birthdays are this week and what could I give?
suggestions.spending: How much did I spend this month and on what?
suggestions.diary: What did I write in my diary last week?

settings.title: AI settings
settings.privacy: Data needed for an answer is sent to the selected provider. For full privacy, use a local model via Ollama.
settings.apiKeySaved: saved — leave empty to keep it
settings.apiKeyHint: Stored encrypted on the server. Not needed for Ollama.
settings.morningDigest: Morning digest at 08:30: the weather and what changed since yesterday (stars, websites, birthdays, payments, game records, music)
settings.connectionFailed: Could not connect: check the URL, model and key

errors.api: The AI provider returned an error. Check the key and balance in the settings or switch to another connection.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.

connections.title: Connections
connections.name: Name
connections.empty: No connections yet: add one to start using AI.
connections.confirmDelete: Delete the “{{name}}” connection and its key?

speech.title: Voice messages in Telegram
speech.hint: The bot turns a voice message into text and handles it like a typed one. It needs a connection with speech recognition — OpenAI (DeepSeek has none).
